banner.subTitle: Legal Terms & Healthcare Equipment Procurement Agreement

termsPage.introduction: Welcome to Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd. By accessing our website, purchasing our biomedical equipment, utilizing our clinical engineering services, or entering into distribution agreements with us, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing this website, requesting quotes, or procuring medical machinery, diagnostic systems, surgical disposables, and turnkey engineering solutions from Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions in full compliance with relevant Pakistani healthcare regulations and DRAP (Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan) guidelines.

sections.title: 2. Equipment Quotations & Orders
sections.content: All formal quotations issued for medical equipment, laboratory diagnostic analyzers, and surgical disposables are subject to principal availability, currency fluctuation adjustments, and official written confirmation. Purchase orders placed by hospitals, clinical laboratories, or distribution partners become binding upon written confirmation from Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd.

sections.title: 3. Turnkey Installation, Warranty & Calibration
sections.content: All biomedical devices distributed by Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd are installed, tested, and calibrated by qualified biomedical engineers. Warranty coverage covers manufacturer defects as stipulated in the formal contract. Unauthorized repairs, tampering by uncertified personnel, or improper electrical/environmental site conditions shall void the warranty coverage.

sections.title: 4. Service Level Agreements & 24/7 Emergency Support
sections.content: Emergency technical support, scheduled preventive maintenance, and spare parts supply are provided according to the executed Service Level Agreement (SLA). Emergency dispatch turnaround times apply to designated critical care units, ICUs, and surgical suites under active service contracts.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Clinical Liability
sections.content: Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from improper equipment operation, unapproved clinical application, or failure to follow operator training instructions provided during official equipment handover.

sections.title: 6. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
sections.content: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. Any legal disputes arising in connection with these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan.

banner.title: Privacy Policy
banner.subTitle: Your Data Protection & Confidentiality at Innotech Medical

privacyPage.introduction: Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd ("we", "our", or "us") is dedicated to protecting the privacy, confidentiality, and security of our healthcare partners, client hospitals, laboratories, clinicians, and website visitors across Pakistan.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect institutional and contact information necessary to provide biomedical equipment distribution, technical maintenance, customer support, and clinical newsletter updates. This includes names, hospital/laboratory affiliations, professional email addresses, telephone numbers, shipping addresses, and equipment inquiry details.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used strictly to process equipment procurement orders, dispatch biomedical engineers for on-site calibration, coordinate emergency maintenance, provide regulatory compliance documents, respond to live support inquiries, and send critical product updates.

sections.title: 3. Data Security & Confidentiality
sections.content: We implement industry-standard technical and organizational security protocols, including encrypted communications and secure server storage, to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction of your institutional and personal information.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Sharing & Compliance
sections.content: Innotech Medical Pvt Ltd does not sell, lease, or trade your information to third parties. We share information only with authorized logistics providers, OEM principal manufacturers for warranty registrations, or regulatory authorities when mandated by Pakistani healthcare law.

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Analytics
sections.content: Our website uses analytical cookies solely to monitor website traffic, enhance user browsing experience, and optimize our medical catalog presentation. You can manage or disable cookie preferences through your web browser settings.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights & Contact Information
sections.content: You have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about your facility, request corrections or updates, or request removal from our promotional and newsletter mailing lists at any time by contacting our support team.
